meta.name: crisis-recovery-governance
meta.description: Use when a new ruler inherits a troubled state and must restore stability. Covers personnel reform (任忠贤), correcting predecessor's wrongs (正先帝之过), economic relief (发仓廪/轻赋), legal simplification (约法/省刑), and moral governance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 恢复动荡国家的稳定与治理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果新接手一个混乱局面，需要系统性的恢复方案。
copy.tagline_en: Restore stability and governance in a troubled state
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherit a troubled state and need a systematic recovery plan.

howto.what: Claude 会按照五个步骤（人事改革、纠正前任错误、经济救济、法律简化、道德治理）给出具体的治国行动建议，例如任命忠贤、开仓放粮、减税省刑等。
howto.when: 当你描述自己刚接手一个内部危机四伏、民怨沸腾的国家，需要恢复稳定时触发。

say.text: 我刚即位，国家动荡，该怎么整顿朝纲？
say.note: Claude 会按步骤给出改革建议。

say.text: 先帝留下很多冤案，如何纠正并安抚百姓？
say.note: Claude 会具体说明平反措施。

say.text: 经济凋敝，如何开仓济民、减轻赋税？
say.note: Claude 会列出经济救济步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude will provide specific governance advice following five steps: personnel reform (appoint loyal and wise officials), correct predecessor's wrongs, economic relief (open granaries, reduce taxes), legal simplification, and moral governance. It outputs a detailed action list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe inheriting a troubled state with internal crisis and popular discontent, needing stability restoration.

say_en.text: I've just ascended the throne amid turmoil. How should I reform the government?
My predecessor left many injustices. How can I correct them and appease the people?
The economy is in shambles. How to distribute grain and reduce taxes?
say_en.note: Claude will list economic relief steps.
